svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Memory time versus compute time for one decoded token
svg.desc: For a 7 billion parameter FP16 model on an A100-class GPU, moving the weights from HBM takes about 7 milliseconds per token, while the arithmetic takes about 0.045 milliseconds, roughly 155 times less.
svg.text: One decode step, batch 1: Llama-2-7B in FP16 on an A100-class GPU
Move the weights from HBM to the SMs
Same scale: the GPU waits on memory about 155 times longer than it computes.
